title: Нет writable agent: defaultReturnStage nil и pipeline no_return_target

validatePipeline.content:
version: 1
stages:
  - id: backlog
    kind: queue
    on_success: review
  - id: review
    kind: agent
    agent: {model: composer-2, permissions: read-only}
    on_success: human
  - id: human
    kind: human
    on_success: merge
  - id: merge
    kind: merge
    on_success: done
  - id: done
    kind: terminal

note: Spec v0.8.24 §1.3: для requestChanges нет editable agent → global issue path stages без stageId. Дополнительный merge no_return_target тоже допустим; issues expectation subset, не exact count. Проверить resolved.defaultReturnStage=nil будущим daemon oracle, check сейчас only typed issues. Архитектура §3.1.
